components.name: Proof stamp
components.html: RSS フィードを開く
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-proof); color: var(--color-accent-deep); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-stamp:hover { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Foundry rail
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 4.75rem; background: var(--color-rail); border-right: 1px solid var(--color-line); font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-rail ol { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.65rem; } .ds-rail ol li:first-child { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-rail a { color: var(--color-ink-soft); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.62rem; } .ds-rail a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-accent); }

narrative.overview: The site is a foundry specimen sheet hung in north light: zinc plate, sumi, one vermilion proof mark. Changelog entries are cuts of the same face, largest first. The old mist-teal optical-serif room is an anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc ground, sumi ink, vermilion proof only
Kaisei Decol display / BIZ UDPGothic body / Martian Mono point sizes
Square stamps, no pills, no drop shadows
Focus (R) rakes light; it does not add chrome

rules.name: The One Impression Rule
rules.body: Do not polish entries into plaza metrics.

rules.name: The One Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Accent is a proof mark, never a fill.

rules.name: The Staircase Rule
rules.body: Recency is type size, not a badge.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: No glass pills, no drop shadows.

dos: Do let recency live in type size.
Do rake light for Focus, hide chrome.
donts: Don't restore mist, teal, Fraunces, or IBM Plex.
Don't use pills or equal-size cards as the page structure.
Don't add like counts or rank chrome.
Don't put an eyebrow above a heading.
